atoms.subject: IPB Shared Control
atoms.value: Host multiple durable machine identities without collapsing identity, runtime capability, provenance, execution state, or verification state.
atoms.normalized_value: Host multiple durable machine identities without collapsing identity, runtime capability, provenance, execution state, or verification state.

atoms.subject: IPB Shared Control
atoms.value: Multiple identities may share the backend while retaining independent roots, versions, namespaces, protocols, and provenance.
atoms.normalized_value: Multiple identities may share the backend while retaining independent roots, versions, namespaces, protocols, and provenance.

atoms.subject: IPB Shared Control
atoms.value: Common protocol objects may be shared; identity-specific records are not silently rewritten by shared-layer changes.
atoms.normalized_value: Common protocol objects may be shared; identity-specific records are not silently rewritten by shared-layer changes.

atoms.subject: IPB Shared Control
atoms.value: Identity is separate from runtime capability.
atoms.normalized_value: Identity is separate from runtime capability.

atoms.subject: IPB Shared Control

atoms.subject: IPB Shared Control

atoms.subject: IPB Shared Control

atoms.subject: IPB Shared Control
